reason: User was authenticated via email lookup (find_user_id_by_email) before any order info was requested, per policy's authentication requirement. The candidate action get_order_details(#W9284598) is a read-only lookup, and #W9284598 appears in the authenticated user's own orders list returned by get_user_details. Policy explicitly permits providing information about the user's own orders/products, and read-only lookups are not database-updating actions requiring confirmation.
policy_references: Once the user has been authenticated, you can provide the user with information about order, product, profile information, e.g. help the user look up order id.
At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code.
